verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּהַ֥ר סִינַ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.on: וּמַלִיל יְיָ עִם מֹשֶׁה בְּטּוּרָא דְסִינַי לְמֵימָר
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe on Mount Sinai, saying;

oe.t: Adonoy spoke to Moshe on Mount Sinai, saying;

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כִּ֤י תָבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם וְשָׁבְתָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ שַׁבָּ֖ת לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.on: מַלֵל עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן אֲרֵי תֵעַלוּן לְאַרְעָא דִי אֲנָא יָהֵב לְכוֹן וְתַשְּׁמֵט אַרְעָא שְׁמִטְתָא קֳדָם יְיָ
verses.en: Speak to Bnei Yisroel and say to them, when you come to the land which I give to you the land shall be at rest—a Shabbos for Adonoy.

oe.t: Speak to Bnei Yisroel and say to them, when you come to the land which I give to you the land shall be at rest—a Shabbos for [
rest before
] Adonoy.

verses.he: שֵׁ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ תִּזְרַ֣ע שָׂדֶ֔ךָ וְשֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים תִּזְמֹ֣ר כַּרְמֶ֑ךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ אֶת־תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.on: שִׁית שְׁנִין תִּזְרַע חַקְלָךְ וְשִׁית שְׁנִין תִכְסַח כַּרְמָךְ וְתִכְנוֹשׁ יָת עֲלַלְתָּהּ
verses.en: For six years you shall plant your field and for six years you shall prune your vineyard and you shall harvest its produce.

oe.t: For six years you shall plant your field and for six years you shall prune your vineyard and you shall harvest its produce.

verses.he: וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗ת שַׁבַּ֤ת שַׁבָּתוֹן֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָאָ֔רֶץ שַׁבָּ֖ת לַיהוָ֑ה שָֽׂדְךָ֙ לֹ֣א תִזְרָ֔ע וְכַרְמְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תִזְמֹֽר׃
verses.on: וּבְשַׁתָּא שְׁבִיעֲתָא נְיַח שְׁמִטְתָא יְהֵי לְאַרְעָא דְתַשְׁמֵט קֳדָם יְיָ חַקְלָךְ לָא תִזְרַע וְכַרְמָךְ לָא תִכְסָח
verses.en: But the seventh year shall be a Shabbos of rest for the land, a Shabbos for Adonoy, you shall not plant your field and you shall not prune your vineyard.

oe.t: But the seventh year shall be a Shabbos of [
complete
] rest for the land, a Shabbos for [
rest before
] Adonoy, you shall not plant your field and you shall not prune your vineyard.

verses.he: אֵ֣ת סְפִ֤יחַ קְצִֽירְךָ֙ לֹ֣א תִקְצ֔וֹר וְאֶת־עִנְּבֵ֥י נְזִירֶ֖ךָ לֹ֣א תִבְצֹ֑ר שְׁנַ֥ת שַׁבָּת֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֥ה לָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.on: יָת כַּתֵּי דַחֲצָדָךְ לָא תֶחֱצַד וְיָת עִנְבֵי שִׁבְקָךְ לָא תִקְטוֹף שְׁנַת שְׁמִטְתָא יְהֵי לְאַרְעָא
verses.en: [Even] crops that grew on their own [from the seeds of your previous] harvest you shall not reap, and the grapes of your untended vines you shall not gather; it shall be a year of complete rest for the land.

oe.t: [Even] crops that grew on their own [from the seeds of your previous] harvest you shall not reap, and the grapes of your untended vines you shall not gather; it shall be a year of complete rest for the land.

verses.he: וְ֠הָיְתָה שַׁבַּ֨ת הָאָ֤רֶץ לָכֶם֙ לְאָכְלָ֔ה לְךָ֖ וּלְעַבְדְּךָ֣ וְלַאֲמָתֶ֑ךָ וְלִשְׂכִֽירְךָ֙ וּלְתוֹשָׁ֣בְךָ֔ הַגָּרִ֖ים עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.on: וּתְהֵי שְׁמִטַת אַרְעָא לְכוֹן לְמֵיכַל לָךְ וּלְעַבְדָךְ וּלְאַמְתָךְ וְלַאֲגִירָךְ וּלְתוֹתָבָךְ דְדָיְרִין עִמָךְ
verses.en: The [produce] of the lands Shabbos[-year] shall be for yourselves, for food, for you, your servant and your maidservant, for your hired hand and your resident sojourner who reside with you.

oe.t: The [produce] [
rest
] of the lands Shabbos[-year] [
land
] shall be for yourselves, for food, for you, your servant and your maidservant, for your hired hand and your resident sojourner who reside with you.

verses.he: וְלִ֨בְהֶמְתְּךָ֔ וְלַֽחַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאַרְצֶ֑ךָ תִּהְיֶ֥ה כָל־תְּבוּאָתָ֖הּ לֶאֱכֹֽל׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְלִבְעִירָךְ וּלְחַיְתָא דִי בְאַרְעָךְ תְּהֵי כָל עֲלַלְתַּהּ לְמֵיכָל
verses.en: [Also] for your domesticated animals and for the [wild] beasts that are in your land shall all of its produce be for food.

oe.t: [Also] for your domesticated animals and for the [wild] beasts that are in your land shall all of its produce be for food.

verses.he: וְסָפַרְתָּ֣ לְךָ֗ שֶׁ֚בַע שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת שָׁנִ֔ים שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְהָי֣וּ לְךָ֗ יְמֵי֙ שֶׁ֚בַע שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת הַשָּׁנִ֔ים תֵּ֥שַׁע וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.on: וְתִמְנֵי לָךְ שְׁבַע שְׁמִיטִין דִשְׁנִין שְׁבַע שְׁנִין שְׁבַע זִמְנִין וִיהוֹן לָךְ יוֹמֵי שְּׁבַע שְׁמִטִין דִשְׁנִין אַרְבְּעִין וְתֵשַׁע שְׁנִין
verses.en: You shall count for yourself seven sabbatical years, seven years, seven times and it shall be for you, the days (period) of the seven sabbatical years, forty-nine years.

oe.t: You shall count for yourself seven sabbatical years [
of rest
], seven years, seven times and it shall be for you, the days (period) of the seven sabbatical years [
of rest
], forty-nine years.

verses.he: וְהַֽעֲבַרְתָּ֞ שׁוֹפַ֤ר תְּרוּעָה֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִעִ֔י בֶּעָשׂ֖וֹר לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ בְּיוֹם֙ הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים תַּעֲבִ֥ירוּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בְּכָל־אַרְצְכֶֽם׃
verses.on: וְתַעֲבַר שׁוֹפָר יַבָּבָא בְּיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה בְּעַשְׂרָא לְיַרְחָא בְּיוֹמָא דְכִפּוּרַיָא תַּעַבְרוּן שׁוֹפָרָא בְּכָל אַרְעֲכוֹן
verses.en: You shall make a proclamation with the shofor on the tenth day of the seventh month. On Yom Kippur shall this shofor-proclamation be made. throughout all your land.

oe.t: You shall make a proclamation [
crying
] with the shofor on the tenth day of the seventh month. On Yom Kippur shall this shofor-proclamation be made. throughout all your land.

verses.he: וְקִדַּשְׁתֶּ֗ם אֵ֣ת שְׁנַ֤ת הַחֲמִשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּקְרָאתֶ֥ם דְּר֛וֹר בָּאָ֖רֶץ לְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ יוֹבֵ֥ל הִוא֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְשַׁבְתֶּ֗ם אִ֚ישׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזָּת֔וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ תָּשֻֽׁבוּ׃
verses.on: וּתְקַדְשׁוּן יָת שְׁנַת חַמְשִׁין שְׁנִין וְתַקְרוּן חֵרוּתָא בְּאַרְעָא לְכָל יָתְבָהָא יוֹבֵלָא הִיא תְּהֵי לְכוֹן וּתְתוּבוּן גְבַר לְאַחֲסַנְתֵּהּ וּגְבַר לְזַרְעִיתֵהּ תְּתוּבוּן
verses.en: You shall sanctify the year of the fiftieth year and proclaim freedom in the land for all of its inhabitants; it shall be for you a jubilee and each man shall return to his ancestral land and each man shall return to his family.

oe.t: You shall sanctify the year of the fiftieth year and proclaim freedom in the land for all of its inhabitants; it shall be for you a jubilee and each man shall return to his ancestral land and each man shall return to his family.

verses.he: יוֹבֵ֣ל הִ֗וא שְׁנַ֛ת הַחֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם לֹ֣א תִזְרָ֔עוּ וְלֹ֤א תִקְצְרוּ֙ אֶת־סְפִיחֶ֔יהָ וְלֹ֥א תִבְצְר֖וּ אֶת־נְזִרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.on: יוֹבֵלָא הִיא שְׁנַת חַמְשִׁין שְׁנִין תְּהֵי לְכוֹן לָא תִזְרְעוּן וְלָא תַחְצְדוּן יַת כַּתָּהָא וְלָא תִקְטְפוּן יַת שִׁבְקָהָא
verses.en: It is a jubilee, [that] the year of the fiftieth year shall be for you. You shall not plant and you shall not reap [even] crops that grew on their own; and you shall not gather the [grapes of] its untended vineyard,

oe.t: It is a jubilee, [that] the year of the fiftieth year shall be for you. You shall not plant and you shall not reap [even] crops that grew on their own; and you shall not gather the [grapes of] its untended vineyard,

verses.he: כִּ֚י יוֹבֵ֣ל הִ֔וא קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם מִן־הַ֨שָּׂדֶ֔ה תֹּאכְל֖וּ אֶת־תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי יוֹבֵלָא הִיא קוּדְשָׁא תְּהֵי לְכוֹן מִן חַקְלָא תֵּיכְלוּן יָת עֲלַלְתָּהּ
verses.en: For it is a jubilee, it shall be holy to you. Whatever is in the field, you may eat of its produce.

oe.t: For it is a jubilee, it shall be holy to you. Whatever is in the field, you may eat of its produce.

verses.he: בִּשְׁנַ֥ת הַיּוֹבֵ֖ל הַזֹּ֑את תָּשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: בְּשַׁתָּא דְיוֹבֵלָא הָדָא תְּתוּבוּן גְבַר לְאַחֲסַנְתֵּהּ
verses.en: On this jubilee year, each man shall return to his ancestral land.

oe.t: On this jubilee year, each man shall return to his ancestral land.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־תִמְכְּר֤וּ מִמְכָּר֙ לַעֲמִיתֶ֔ךָ א֥וֹ קָנֹ֖ה מִיַּ֣ד עֲמִיתֶ֑ךָ אַל־תּוֹנ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־אָחִֽיו׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי תְזַבֵּן זְבִינִין לְחַבְרָךְ אוֹ תִזְבֵּן מִידָא דְחַבְרָךְ לָא תוֹנוּן גְבַר יָת אֲחוֹהִי
verses.en: If you sell anything to your neighbor, or purchase [something] from your neighbor, do not cheat one another.

oe.t: If you sell anything to your neighbor, or purchase [something] from your neighbor, do not cheat one another.

verses.he: בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שָׁנִים֙ אַחַ֣ר הַיּוֹבֵ֔ל תִּקְנֶ֖ה מֵאֵ֣ת עֲמִיתֶ֑ךָ בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר שְׁנֵֽי־תְבוּאֹ֖ת יִמְכָּר־לָֽךְ׃
verses.on: בְּמִנְיַן שְׁנַיָא בָּתַר יוֹבֵלָא תִּזְבֵּן מִן חַבְרָךְ בְּמִנְיַן שְׁנֵי עֲלַלְתָּא יְזַבֶּן לָךְ
verses.en: According to the number of years after the jubilee you shall purchase [land] from your neighbor; according to the number of produce years he shall sell it to you.

oe.t: According to the number of years after the jubilee you shall purchase [land] from your neighbor; according to the number of produce years he shall sell it to you.

verses.he: לְפִ֣י ׀ רֹ֣ב הַשָּׁנִ֗ים תַּרְבֶּה֙ מִקְנָת֔וֹ וּלְפִי֙ מְעֹ֣ט הַשָּׁנִ֔ים תַּמְעִ֖יט מִקְנָת֑וֹ כִּ֚י מִסְפַּ֣ר תְּבוּאֹ֔ת ה֥וּא מֹכֵ֖ר לָֽךְ׃
verses.on: לְפוּם סְגִיאוּת שְׁנַיָא תַּסְגֵי זְבִינוֹהִי וּלְפוּם זְעֵרוּת שְׁנַיָא תַּזְעֵר זְבִינוֹהִי אֲרֵי מִנְיַן עֲלַלְתָּא הוּא מְזַבֵּן לָךְ
verses.en: Based on the abundance of years, you shall increase its purchase price and based on the lack of years you shall decrease its purchase price, since it is the number of produce-seasons that he is selling to you.

oe.t: Based on the abundance of years, you shall increase its purchase price and based on the lack of years you shall decrease its purchase price, since it is the number of produce-seasons that he is selling to you.

verses.he: וְלֹ֤א תוֹנוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־עֲמִית֔וֹ וְיָרֵ֖אתָ מֵֽאֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: וְלָא תוֹנוּן גְבַר יָת חַבְרֵהּ וְתִדְחַל מֵאֱלָהָךְ אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהֲכוֹן
verses.en: You shall not cheat one another, and you shall fear your God for I am Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: You shall not cheat one another, and you shall fear your God for I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֙ אֶת־חֻקֹּתַ֔י וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֥י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם אֹתָ֑ם וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ לָבֶֽטַח׃
verses.on: וְתַעְבְּדוּן יָת קְיָמַי וְיָת דִינַי תִּטְּרוּן וְתַעֲבְּדוּן יָתְהוֹן וְתֵיתְבוּן עַל אַרְעָא לְרָחֲצָן
verses.en: You shall fulfill My statutes and keep My laws and fulfill them, and you will then live in the land in security.

oe.t: You shall fulfill My statutes and keep My laws and fulfill them, and you will then live in the land in security.

verses.he: וְנָתְנָ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ פִּרְיָ֔הּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם לָשֹׂ֑בַע וִֽישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לָבֶ֖טַח עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.on: וְתִתֵּן אַרְעָא אִבַּהּ וְתֵיכְלוּן לְמִשְׂבָּע וְתֵיתְבוּן לְרָחֲצָן עֲלַהּ
verses.en: The land will give forth its fruit and you will eat your fill, and you will live securely on it.

oe.t: The land will give forth its fruit and you will eat your fill, and you will live securely on it.

verses.he: וְכִ֣י תֹאמְר֔וּ מַה־נֹּאכַ֤֖ל בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑ת הֵ֚ן לֹ֣א נִזְרָ֔ע וְלֹ֥א נֶאֱסֹ֖ף אֶת־תְּבוּאָתֵֽנוּ׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי תֵימְרוּן מָא נֵיכוּל בְּשַׁתָּא שְׁבִיעֵתָא הָא לָא נִזְרָע וְלָא נִכְנוֹשׁ יָת עֲלַלְתָּנָא
verses.en: If you shall say (ask) What will we eat in the seventh year, for lo! we have not planted nor gathered our produce?

oe.t: If you shall say (ask) What will we eat in the seventh year, for lo! we have not planted nor gathered our produce?

verses.he: וְצִוִּ֤יתִי אֶת־בִּרְכָתִי֙ לָכֶ֔ם בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הַשִּׁשִּׁ֑ית וְעָשָׂת֙ אֶת־הַתְּבוּאָ֔ה לִשְׁלֹ֖שׁ הַשָּׁנִֽים׃
verses.on: וֶאֱפַקֵד יָת בִּרְכְּתִי לְכוֹן בְּשַׁתָּא שְׁתִיתֵתָא וְתַעְבֵּד יָת עֲלַלְתָּא לִתְלַת שְׁנִין
verses.en: I shall command (direct) My blessing to you in the sixth year and it will produce [enough] for three years.

oe.t: I shall command (direct) My blessing to you in the sixth year and it will produce [enough] for three years.

verses.he: וּזְרַעְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת הַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁמִינִ֔ת וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם מִן־הַתְּבוּאָ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ן עַ֣ד ׀ הַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַתְּשִׁיעִ֗ת עַד־בּוֹא֙ תְּב֣וּאָתָ֔הּ תֹּאכְל֖וּ יָשָֽׁן׃
verses.on: וְתִזְרְעוּן יָת שַׁתָּא תְמִינֵתָא וְתֵיכְלוּן מִן עֲלַלְתָּא עַתִּיקָא עַד שַׁתָּא תְשִׁיעֵתָא עַד מֵעַל עֲלַלְתַּהּ תֵּיכְלוּן עַתִּיקָא
verses.en: You shall plant in the eighth year but you will still be eating from the old produce until the ninth year; until the [new] produce arrives (ripens) you shall eat [from] the old.

oe.t: You shall plant in the eighth year but you will still be eating from the old produce until the ninth year; until the [new] produce arrives (ripens) you shall eat [from] the old.

verses.he: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ לֹ֤א תִמָּכֵר֙ לִצְמִתֻ֔ת כִּי־לִ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־גֵרִ֧ים וְתוֹשָׁבִ֛ים אַתֶּ֖ם עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.on: וְאַרְעָא לָא תִזְדַבַּן לַחֲלוּטִין אֲרֵי דִילִי אַרְעָא אֲרֵי דַיָרִין וְתוֹתָבִין אַתּוּן קֳדָמַי
verses.en: The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is Mine, for, you are [merely as] foreigners and resident aliens before Me.

oe.t: The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is Mine, for, you are [merely as] foreigners [
foreign resident
] and resident aliens [
residents
] before Me.

verses.he: וּבְכֹ֖ל אֶ֣רֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶ֑ם גְּאֻלָּ֖ה תִּתְּנ֥וּ לָאָֽרֶץ׃ (ס)
verses.on: וּבְכֹל אַרְעָא אַחֲסַנְתְּכוֹן פֻּרְקָנָא תִּתְּנוּן לְאַרְעָא
verses.en: In all of your ancestral lands you shall grant redemption to the land.

oe.t: In all of your ancestral lands you shall grant redemption to the land.

verses.he: כִּֽי־יָמ֣וּךְ אָחִ֔יךָ וּמָכַ֖ר מֵאֲחֻזָּת֑וֹ וּבָ֤א גֹֽאֲלוֹ֙ הַקָּרֹ֣ב אֵלָ֔יו וְגָאַ֕ל אֵ֖ת מִמְכַּ֥ר אָחִֽיו׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי יִתְמַסְכַּן אָחוּךְ וִיזַבֵּן מֵאַחֲסַנְתֵּהּ וְיֵיתֵי פָרִיקֵהּ דְקָרִיב לֵהּ וְיִפְרוֹק יָת זְבִינֵי אֲחוּהִי
verses.en: If your brother becomes impoverished and sells some of his ancestral land, and a close relative comes and redeems that which his brother sold.

oe.t: If your brother becomes impoverished and sells some of his ancestral land, and a close relative comes and redeems that which his brother sold.

verses.he: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־לּ֖וֹ גֹּאֵ֑ל וְהִשִּׂ֣יגָה יָד֔וֹ וּמָצָ֖א כְּדֵ֥י גְאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי לָא יְהֵי לֵהּ פָּרִיק וְתַדְבֵּק יְדֵהּ וְיַשְׁכַּח כְּמִסַת פֻּרְקָנֵהּ
verses.en: [Or] if the man has no redeemer (close relative) but has acquired sufficient means and finds [it] enough to redeem it [himself],

oe.t: [Or] if the man has no redeemer (close relative) but has acquired sufficient means and finds [it] enough to redeem it [himself],

verses.he: וְחִשַּׁב֙ אֶת־שְׁנֵ֣י מִמְכָּר֔וֹ וְהֵשִׁיב֙ אֶת־הָ֣עֹדֵ֔ף לָאִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽכַר־ל֑וֹ וְשָׁ֖ב לַאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וִיחַשֵׁב יָת שְׁנֵי זְבִינוֹהִי וְיָתֵב יָת מוֹתָרָא לִגְבַר דִי זַבֶּן לֵהּ וִיתוּב לְאַחֲסַנְתֵּהּ
verses.en: He shall calculate the number of years for which he sold the land and return the remainder (excess) to the man to whom he had sold it, and he shall return to his ancestral land.

oe.t: He shall calculate the number of years for which he sold the land and return the remainder (excess) to the man to whom he had sold it, and he shall return to his ancestral land.

verses.he: וְאִ֨ם לֹֽא־מָֽצְאָ֜ה יָד֗וֹ דֵּי֮ הָשִׁ֣יב לוֹ֒ וְהָיָ֣ה מִמְכָּר֗וֹ בְּיַד֙ הַקֹּנֶ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיּוֹבֵ֑ל וְיָצָא֙ בַּיֹּבֵ֔ל וְשָׁ֖ב לַאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְאִם לָא תַשְׁכַּח יְדֵהּ כְּמִסַת אֲתֵב לֵהּ וִיהֵי זְבִינוֹהִי בִּידָא דִזְבַן יָתֵהּ עַד שַׁתָּא דְיוֹבֵלָא וְיִפּוֹק בְּיוֹבֵלָא וִיתוּב לְאַחֲסַנְתֵּהּ
verses.en: Or if he does not have within his means enough to retrieve the land to himself, then that which he sold remains in the possession of the buyer until the jubilee year. It is then released by the jubilee and he [the seller] returns to his ancestral land.

oe.t: Or if he does not have within his means enough to retrieve the land to himself, then that which he sold remains in the possession of the buyer until the jubilee year. It is then released by the jubilee and he [the seller] returns to his ancestral land.

verses.he: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־יִמְכֹּ֤ר בֵּית־מוֹשַׁב֙ עִ֣יר חוֹמָ֔ה וְהָיְתָה֙ גְּאֻלָּת֔וֹ עַד־תֹּ֖ם שְׁנַ֣ת מִמְכָּר֑וֹ יָמִ֖ים תִּהְיֶ֥ה גְאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יְזַבֵּן בֵּית מוֹתַב קַרְתָּא מַקְפָא שׁוּר וּתְהֵי פוּרְקָנֵהּ עַד מִשְׁלַם שַׁתָּא דִזְבִינוֹהִי עִדָן בְּעִדָן תְּהֵי פוּרְקָנֵהּ
verses.en: If a man shall sell a residential home [that is] within a walled city, the time allotted for its redemption shall be until the end of one year after he sold it. He has the days [of a full year] in which to redeem it.

oe.t: If a man shall sell a residential home [that is] within [
surrounded by
] a walled city, the time allotted for its redemption shall be until the end of one year after he sold it. He has the days [of a full year] in which to redeem it.

verses.he: וְאִ֣ם לֹֽא־יִגָּאֵ֗ל עַד־מְלֹ֣את לוֹ֮ שָׁנָ֣ה תְמִימָה֒ וְ֠קָם הַבַּ֨יִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּעִ֜יר אֲשֶׁר־לא [ל֣וֹ] חֹמָ֗ה לַצְּמִיתֻ֛ת לַקֹּנֶ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ לְדֹרֹתָ֑יו לֹ֥א יֵצֵ֖א בַּיֹּבֵֽל׃
verses.on: וְאִם לָא יִתְפָּרַק עַד מִשְׁלַם לֵהּ שַׁתָּא שְׁלֶמְתָּא וִיקוּם בֵּיתָא דִי בְקַרְתָּא דִי לֵהּ שׁוּרָא לַחֲלוּטִין לְדִי זְבַן יָתֵהּ לְדָרוֹהִי לָא יִפּוֹק בְּיוֹבֵלָא
verses.en: If he does not redeem it by the end of a full year, the house within the city that is surrounded by a wall shall then remain in perpetuity to its purchaser for his generations (descendants.) It is not released by the jubilee.

oe.t: If he does not redeem it by the end of a full year, the house within the city that is surrounded by a wall shall then remain in perpetuity to its purchaser for his generations (descendants.) It is not released by the jubilee.

verses.he: וּבָתֵּ֣י הַחֲצֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵין־לָהֶ֤ם חֹמָה֙ סָבִ֔יב עַל־שְׂדֵ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב גְּאֻלָּה֙ תִּהְיֶה־לּ֔וֹ וּבַיֹּבֵ֖ל יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.on: וּבָתֵּי פַצְחַיָא דִי לֵית לְהוֹן שׁוּר מַקַף סְחוֹר סְחוֹר עַל חֲקַל אַרְעָא יִתְחַשָׁב פֻּרְקָנָא תְּהֵי לֵהּ וּבְיוֹבֵלָא יִפּוֹק
verses.en: The houses of open cities which are not surrounded by a wall shall be considered as a field of the land. It shall have a redemption and it is released by the jubilee.

oe.t: The houses of open cities which are not surrounded by a [
an encircling
] wall shall be considered as a field of the land. It shall have a redemption and it is released by the jubilee.

verses.he: וְעָרֵי֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם בָּתֵּ֖י עָרֵ֣י אֲחֻזָּתָ֑ם גְּאֻלַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.on: וְקִרְוֵי לֵיוָאֵי בָּתֵּי קִרְוֵי אַחֲסַנְתְּהוֹן פּוּרְקַן עָלָם תְּהֵי לְלֵיוָאֵי
verses.en: The cities of the Levites the houses in the cities of their ancestral land, the Levites shall have an eternal right of redemption.

oe.t: The cities of the Levites the houses in the cities of their ancestral land, the Levites shall have an eternal right of redemption.

verses.he: וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִגְאַל֙ מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְיָצָ֧א מִמְכַּר־בַּ֛יִת וְעִ֥יר אֲחֻזָּת֖וֹ בַּיֹּבֵ֑ל כִּ֣י בָתֵּ֞י עָרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּ֗ם הִ֚וא אֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.on: וְדִי יִפְרוֹק מִן לֵיוָאֵי וְיִפּוֹק זְבִין בֵּיתָא וְקַרְתָּא אַחֲסַנְתֵּהּ בְּיוֹבֵלָא אֲרֵי בָתֵּי קִרְוֵי לֵיוָאֵי הִיא אַחְסַנְתְּהוֹן בְּגוֹ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
verses.en: If anyone redeems [a house or field] from the Levites, then the house or his ancestral city shall be released by the jubilee, for the houses of the Levitic cities are [considered] their ancestral lands among Bnei Yisroel.

oe.t: If anyone redeems [a house or field] from the Levites, then the house or his ancestral city shall be released by the jubilee, for the houses of the Levitic cities are [considered] their ancestral lands among Bnei Yisroel.

verses.he: וּֽשְׂדֵ֛ה מִגְרַ֥שׁ עָרֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א יִמָּכֵ֑ר כִּֽי־אֲחֻזַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם ה֖וּא לָהֶֽם׃ (ס)
verses.on: וַחֲקַל רְוַח קִרְוֵיהוֹן לָא יִזְדַבָּן אֲרֵי אַחֲסָנַת עָלָם הוּא לְהוֹן
verses.en: The field on the outskirts of their cities may not be sold for it is their perpetual ancestral land.

oe.t: The field on the outskirts of their cities may not be sold for it is their perpetual ancestral land.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־יָמ֣וּךְ אָחִ֔יךָ וּמָ֥טָה יָד֖וֹ עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהֶֽחֱזַ֣קְתָּ בּ֔וֹ גֵּ֧ר וְתוֹשָׁ֛ב וָחַ֖י עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי יִתְמַסְכַּן אָחוּךְ וּתְמוּט יְדֵהּ עִמָךְ וְתַתְקַף בֵּהּ דַיַר וְתוֹתָב וִיחֵי עִמָךְ
verses.en: If your brother becomes impoverished and his hand (assets) become shaky among you, you must support him, [so too] the proselyte and the sojourner, [so] that he shall live with you.

oe.t: If your brother becomes impoverished and his hand (assets) become shaky among you, you must support him, [so too] the proselyte [
foreign resident
] and the sojourner, [so] that he shall live with you.

verses.he: אַל־תִּקַּ֤ח מֵֽאִתּוֹ֙ נֶ֣שֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּ֔ית וְיָרֵ֖אתָ מֵֽאֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְחֵ֥י אָחִ֖יךָ עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.on: לָא תִסַב מִנֵהּ חִבּוּלְיָא וְרִבִּיתָא וְתִדְחַל מֵאֱלָהָךְ וִיחֵי אָחוּךְ עִמָךְ
verses.en: You shall not take from him interest or usury and you shall fear your God, and your brother shall live with you.

oe.t: You shall not take from him interest or usury and you shall fear your God, and your brother shall live with you.

verses.he: אֶ֨ת־כַּסְפְּךָ֔ לֹֽא־תִתֵּ֥ן ל֖וֹ בְּנֶ֑שֶׁךְ וּבְמַרְבִּ֖ית לֹא־תִתֵּ֥ן אָכְלֶֽךָ׃
verses.on: יָת כַּסְפָּךְ לָא תִתֵּן לֵהּ בְּחִבּוּלְיָא וּבְרִבִּיתָא לָא תִתֵּן מֵיכְלָךְ
verses.en: You must not give (lend) him your money with interest, and usuriously you must not advance him your food.

oe.t: You must not give (lend) him your money with interest, and usuriously you must not advance him your food.

verses.he: אֲנִ֗י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לָתֵ֤ת לָכֶם֙ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃ (ס)
verses.on: אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהֲכוֹן דִי אַפֵּקִית יָתְכוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם לְמִתַּן לְכוֹן יָת אַרְעָא דִכְנַעַן לְמֶהֱוֵי לְכוֹן לֶאֱלָהּ
verses.en: I am Adonoy your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, to be a God for you.

oe.t: I am Adonoy your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, to be a God for you.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־יָמ֥וּךְ אָחִ֛יךָ עִמָּ֖ךְ וְנִמְכַּר־לָ֑ךְ לֹא־תַעֲבֹ֥ד בּ֖וֹ עֲבֹ֥דַת עָֽבֶד׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי יִתְמַסְכַּן אָחוּךְ עִמָךְ וְיִזְדַבַּן לָךְ לָא תִפְלַח בֵּהּ פָּלְחַן עַבְדִין
verses.en: If your brother becomes impoverished and is sold to you, you must not work him like a slave.

oe.t: If your brother becomes impoverished and is sold to you, you must not work him like a slave [
slaves

verses.he: כְּשָׂכִ֥יר כְּתוֹשָׁ֖ב יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֑ךְ עַד־שְׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל יַעֲבֹ֥ד עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.on: כַּאֲגִירָא כְתוֹתָבָא יְהֵי עִמָךְ עַד שַׁתָּא דְיוֹבֵלָא יִפְלַח עִמָךְ
verses.en: Like a hired hand or resident [worker] shall he be with you He shall serve you until the jubilee year.

oe.t: Like a hired hand or resident [worker] shall he be with you He shall serve you until the jubilee year.

verses.he: וְיָצָא֙ מֵֽעִמָּ֔ךְ ה֖וּא וּבָנָ֣יו עִמּ֑וֹ וְשָׁב֙ אֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֔וֹ וְאֶל־אֲחֻזַּ֥ת אֲבֹתָ֖יו יָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.on: וְיִפּוֹק מֵעִמָךְ הוּא וּבְנוֹהִי עִמֵהּ וִיתוּב לְזַרְעִיתֵהּ וּלְאַחֲסָנַת אֲבָהָתוֹהִי יְתוּב
verses.en: Then he and his children shall depart from you and return to his own family. He shall return to his ancestral estate.

oe.t: Then he and his children shall depart from you and return to his own family. He shall return to his ancestral estate.

verses.he: כִּֽי־עֲבָדַ֣י הֵ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לֹ֥א יִמָּכְר֖וּ מִמְכֶּ֥רֶת עָֽבֶד׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי עַבְדַי אִנוּן דִי אַפֵּקִית יָתְהוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם לָא יִזְדַבְּנוּן זְבוּן עַבְדִין
verses.en: For they are My servants, whom I brought out from the land of Egypt, they shall not be sold [in the market] as slaves.

oe.t: For they are My servants, whom I brought out from the land of Egypt, they shall not be sold [in the market] as slaves.

verses.he: לֹא־תִרְדֶּ֥ה ב֖וֹ בְּפָ֑רֶךְ וְיָרֵ֖אתָ מֵאֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.on: לָא תִפְלָח בֵּהּ בְּקַשְׁיוּ וְתִדְחַל מֵאֱלָהָךְ
verses.en: You must not rule over him to crush him and you shall fear your God.

oe.t: You must not rule over him [
make him work
] to crush him and you shall fear your God.

verses.he: וְעַבְדְּךָ֥ וַאֲמָתְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיוּ־לָ֑ךְ מֵאֵ֣ת הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם מֵהֶ֥ם תִּקְנ֖וּ עֶ֥בֶד וְאָמָֽה׃
verses.on: וְעַבְדָךְ וְאַמְתָךְ דִי יְהוֹן לָךְ מִן עַמְמַיָא דִי בְסַחֲרָנֵיכוֹן מִנְהוֹן תִּקְנוּן עַבְדִין וְאַמְהָן
verses.en: Your slaves and maidservants that you shall possess from the nations that surround you, from them you may purchase slaves and maidservants.

oe.t: Your slaves and maidservants that you shall possess from the nations that surround you, from them you may purchase slaves and maidservants.

verses.he: וְ֠גַם מִבְּנֵ֨י הַתּוֹשָׁבִ֜ים הַגָּרִ֤ים עִמָּכֶם֙ מֵהֶ֣ם תִּקְנ֔וּ וּמִמִּשְׁפַּחְתָּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמָּכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹלִ֖ידוּ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֑ם וְהָי֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם לַֽאֲחֻזָּֽה׃
verses.on: וְאַף מִבְּנֵי תוֹתָבַיָא עָרְלַיָא דְדָיְרִין עִמְכוֹן מִנְהוֹן תִּקְנוּן וּמִזַרְעִיתְהוֹן דְעִמְכוֹן דִי אִתְיְלִידוּ בְּאַרְעֲכוֹן וִיהוֹן לְכוֹן לְאַחֲסָנָא
verses.en: Also, from the children of the sojourners who reside with you from them you may purchase [slaves], and from their families that live among you that were born in your land. [All these] shall be your permanent possession.

oe.t: Also, from the children of the [
uncircumcised
] sojourners who reside with you from them you may purchase [slaves], and from their families that live among you that were born in your land. [All these] shall be your permanent possession.

verses.he: וְהִתְנַחֲלְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֜ם לִבְנֵיכֶ֤ם אַחֲרֵיכֶם֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֲחֻזָּ֔ה לְעֹלָ֖ם בָּהֶ֣ם תַּעֲבֹ֑דוּ וּבְאַ֨חֵיכֶ֤ם בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אִ֣ישׁ בְּאָחִ֔יו לֹא־תִרְדֶּ֥ה ב֖וֹ בְּפָֽרֶךְ׃ (ס)
verses.on: וְתַחֲסוּן יָתְהוֹן לִבְנֵיכוֹן בַּתְרֵיכוֹן לִירוּתַת אַחֲסָנָא לְעָלָם בְּהוֹן תִּפְלְחוּן וּבְאֲחֵיכוֹן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל גְבַר בַּאֲחוּהִי לָא תִפְלַח בֵּהּ בְּקַשְׁיוּ
verses.en: You shall will them as inheritance to your children after you as hereditary property; you shall keep them in servitude permanently. However regarding your bretheren, Bnei Yisroel, man over his brother, you must not rule over him to crush him.

oe.t: You shall will them as inheritance to your children after you as hereditary property; you shall keep them in servitude permanently. However regarding your bretheren, Bnei Yisroel, man over his brother, you must not rule over him [
make him work
] to crush him.

verses.he: וְכִ֣י תַשִּׂ֗יג יַ֣ד גֵּ֤ר וְתוֹשָׁב֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ וּמָ֥ךְ אָחִ֖יךָ עִמּ֑וֹ וְנִמְכַּ֗ר לְגֵ֤ר תּוֹשָׁב֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ א֥וֹ לְעֵ֖קֶר מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת גֵּֽר׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי תַדְבֵּק יַד עָרֵל וְתוֹתָב עִמָךְ וְיִתְמַסְכַּן אָחוּךְ עִמֵהּ וְיִזְדַבַּן לְעָרֵל תּוֹתָב עִמָךְ אוֹ לְאַרְמַי זַרְעִית גִיוֹרָא
verses.en: If a foreigner or resident acquires means while your brother becomes impoverished by him, and is sold to a resident foreigner who resides with you or to the offspring of a foreign family.

oe.t: If a foreigner [
an uncircumcised one
] or resident acquires means while your brother becomes impoverished by him, and is sold to a [
an uncircumcised
] resident foreigner who resides with you or to the offspring [
a non-Jew
] of a foreign [
proselyte
] family.

verses.he: אַחֲרֵ֣י נִמְכַּ֔ר גְּאֻלָּ֖ה תִּהְיֶה־לּ֑וֹ אֶחָ֥ד מֵאֶחָ֖יו יִגְאָלֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.on: בָּתַר דְיִזְדַבַּן פֻּרְקָנָא תְּהֵי לֵהּ חַד מֵאֲחוֹהִי יִפְרְקִנֵהּ
verses.en: After he is sold redemption shall be his, one of his bretheren shall redeem him.

oe.t: After he is sold redemption shall be his, one of his bretheren shall redeem him.

verses.he: אוֹ־דֹד֞וֹ א֤וֹ בֶן־דֹּדוֹ֙ יִגְאָלֶ֔נּוּ אֽוֹ־מִשְּׁאֵ֧ר בְּשָׂר֛וֹ מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ יִגְאָלֶ֑נּוּ אֽוֹ־הִשִּׂ֥יגָה יָד֖וֹ וְנִגְאָֽל׃
verses.on: אוֹ אַח אֲבוּהִּי אוֹ בַר אַח אֲבוּהִי יִפְרְקִנֵהּ אוֹ מִקָרִיב בִּשְׂרֵהּ מִזַרְעִיתֵהּ יִפְרְקִנֵהּ אוֹ דְתַדְבֵּק יְדֵהּ וְיִתְפָּרָק
verses.en: Either his uncle or his uncles son (cousin) shall redeem him or the closest (other) family relative shall redeem him. If he obtains sufficient means of his own he may be redeemed [on his own.]

oe.t: Either his uncle [
father’s brother
] or his uncles son [
the son of his father’s brother
] (cousin) shall redeem him or the closest (other) family relative shall redeem him. If he obtains sufficient means of his own he may be redeemed [on his own.]

verses.he: וְחִשַּׁב֙ עִם־קֹנֵ֔הוּ מִשְּׁנַת֙ הִמָּ֣כְרוֹ ל֔וֹ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֑ל וְהָיָ֞ה כֶּ֤סֶף מִמְכָּרוֹ֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שָׁנִ֔ים כִּימֵ֥י שָׂכִ֖יר יִהְיֶ֥ה עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וִיחַשֵׁב עִם זָבְנֵהּ מִשַׁתָּא דְאִזְדַבַּן לֵהּ עַד שַׁתָּא דְיוֹבֵלָא וִיהֵי כְּסַף זְבִינוֹהִי בְּמִנְיַן שְׁנַיָא כְּיוֹמֵי אֲגִירָא יְהֵי עִמֵהּ
verses.en: He shall reckon with the one who bought him. [According to the number of years] from the year which he was sold to him until the jubilee year. His purchase price shall be [proportional] to the number of years; at the rate of the days of a hired hand it shall be [considered as he worked] with him.

oe.t: He shall reckon with the one who bought him. [According to the number of years] from the year which he was sold to him until the jubilee year. His purchase price shall be [proportional] to the number of years; at the rate of the days of a hired hand it shall be [considered as he worked] with him.

verses.he: אִם־ע֥וֹד רַבּ֖וֹת בַּשָּׁנִ֑ים לְפִיהֶן֙ יָשִׁ֣יב גְּאֻלָּת֔וֹ מִכֶּ֖סֶף מִקְנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: אִם עוֹד סְגִיוּת בִּשְׁנַיָא לְפוּמְהֵן יָתֵב פֻּרְקָנֵהּ מִכְּסַף זְבִינוֹהִי
verses.en: If there are yet many years [until the jubilee] accordingly shall he return his redemption money from his purchase price.

oe.t: If there are yet many years [until the jubilee] accordingly shall he return his redemption money from his purchase price.

verses.he: וְאִם־מְעַ֞ט נִשְׁאַ֧ר בַּשָּׁנִ֛ים עַד־שְׁנַ֥ת הַיֹּבֵ֖ל וְחִשַּׁב־ל֑וֹ כְּפִ֣י שָׁנָ֔יו יָשִׁ֖יב אֶת־גְּאֻלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְאִם זְעֵר יִשְׁתָּאַר בִּשְׁנַיָא עַד שַׁתָּא דְיוֹבֵלָא וִיחַשֶׁב לֵהּ כְּפוּם שְׁנוֹהִי יָתֵב יָת פּוּרְקָנֵהּ
verses.en: If there remain but a few years until the jubilee year, he shall make a [similar] calculation, based on the number of years he shall return his redemption money [to the purchaser.]

oe.t: If there remain but a few years until the jubilee year, he shall make a [similar] calculation, based on the number of years he shall return his redemption money [to the purchaser.]

verses.he: כִּשְׂכִ֥יר שָׁנָ֛ה בְּשָׁנָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמּ֑וֹ לֹֽא־יִרְדֶּ֥נּֽוּ בְּפֶ֖רֶךְ לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.on: כַּאֲגִיר שְׁנָא בִּשְׁנָא יְהֵי עִמֵהּ לָא יִפְלַח בֵּהּ בְּקַשְׁיוּ לְעֵינָיךְ
verses.en: As a hired hand [working] on a yearly basis shall he be considered with him; he shall not rule over him to crush him before your eyes.

oe.t: As a hired hand [working] on a yearly basis shall he be considered with him; he shall not rule over him [
make him work
] to crush him before your eyes.

verses.he: וְאִם־לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל בְּאֵ֑לֶּה וְיָצָא֙ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת הַיֹּבֵ֔ל ה֖וּא וּבָנָ֥יו עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְאִם לָא יִתְפָּרַק בְּאִלֵין וְיִפּוֹק בְּשַׁתָּא דְיוֹבֵלָא הוּא וּבְנוֹהִי עִמֵהּ
verses.en: If he is not redeemed through these means he then goes out in the jubilee year, he, along with his children.

oe.t: If he is not redeemed through these means he then goes out in the jubilee year, he, along with his children.

verses.he: כִּֽי־לִ֤י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עֲבָדִ֔ים עֲבָדַ֣י הֵ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי דִילִי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדִין עַבְדַי אִנוּן דִי אַפֵּקִית יָתְהוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהֲכוֹן
verses.en: For, Bnei Yisroel are My servants. They are My servants whom I have brought out of the land of Egypt, I am Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: For, Bnei Yisroel are My servants. They are My servants whom I have brought out of the land of Egypt, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: לֹֽא־תַעֲשׂ֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם אֱלִילִ֗ם וּפֶ֤סֶל וּמַצֵּבָה֙ לֹֽא־תָקִ֣ימוּ לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶ֣בֶן מַשְׂכִּ֗ית לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֔ם לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: לָא תַעְבְּדוּן לְכוֹן טַעֲוָן וְצֶלֶם וְקָמָא לָא תְקִימוּן לְכוֹן וְאֶבֶן סָגְדָא לָא תִתְּנוּן בְּאַרְעֲכוֹן לְמִסְגֻד עֲלַהּ אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהֲכוֹן
verses.en: You shall not make idols for yourselves and graven images and memorial stones you shall not raise up for youselves, and a prostration stone you shall not set in your land upon which to prostrate oneself, for I am Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: You shall not make [
false

] idols for yourselves and graven images and memorial stones you shall not raise up for youselves, and a prostration stone you shall not set in your land upon which to prostrate oneself, for I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ (ס)
verses.on: יָת יוֹמֵי שַׁבַּיָא דִילִי תִטְרוּן וּלְבֵית מַקְדְשִׁי תְּהוֹן דָחֲלִין אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: You shall keep My Shabbosos and you shall fear (revere) My Sanctuary, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: You shall keep [
the days of
] My Shabbosos and you shall fear (revere) [
the House of
] My Sanctuary, I am Adonoy.
